name: Tobias
description: Son of Tobit and Anna; sent to Rages to recover his father's money, healed his father's blindness with the gall of a fish on Raphael's instruction, and married Sara the daughter of Raguel

points: One of the Ninevites reported him; he fled for his life, and all his goods were forcibly taken, nothing left him beside his wife Anna and his son Tobias.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The prayers of them both were heard, and Raphael was sent to heal Tobit's eyes and to give Sarah to Tobias, because she belonged to Tobias by right of inheritance.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Raguel had given Tobias half his goods at the wedding, after a fourteen-day feast, with the rest promised when he and his wife were dead; the father-in-law's inheritance passed to the son-in-law.

Tobit died at a hundred and fifty-eight, and after Anna died Tobias went to Ecbatane to Raguel his father-in-law, buried him and his mother-in-law honorably and inherited their substance, and his father Tobit's as well.
Tobias held both lands, his father's and his father-in-law's; hold that, because it is exactly how Joseph comes to stand in two genealogies.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
